subject.title: fix(google): support GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID for Vertex AI

question: Should OpenClaw accept `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` as a Google Vertex project alias across auth evidence and runtime resolution?
rationale: The code shape is focused and proven, but env/config surfaces are high-bar and upstream `@google/genai` only reads `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT`, so maintainer intent should confirm the OpenClaw-owned compatibility alias.

options.title: Accept the additive alias
options.body: Land after normal exact-head merge gates, treating `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` as an OpenClaw-supported Vertex project alias.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask for provider-owner changes if maintainers want docs wording, different precedence, or auth-evidence-only support before expanding runtime recognition.

options.title: Decline the alias
options.body: Close or request removal if maintainers want Google Vertex to stay aligned with upstream SDK env names only.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive alias
recommendation.body: Land after normal exact-head merge gates, treating `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` as an OpenClaw-supported Vertex project alias.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent Google Vertex ADC and provider work makes this the best available routing owner for the env-surface decision.
